profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Kysen Build
profile.summary: Seasoned software engineer well-versed in owning and developing applications through planning, project management, coding, deployment, monitoring, and all the other curveballs along the way.

positions.title: Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
- Work predominantly in a 3-man team divided from a larger group of 15+ developers
- Data mining, pre-processing, and management
- Implement new applications/APIs on a Node.js, Express.js, React.js, NoSQL/MySQL stack
- Discover, design, and implement on a 2-week sprint agile methodology
- Unit testing using Mocha and Ava
- Explore new technologies including Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ, Elm, and more
- Utilize the above to store, analyze, and display social media data on a client-facing dashboard

positions.title: Junior Programmer
positions.description:
- Full Stack Development on applications/APIs using NodeJS, ExpressJS, ReactJS, NoSQL/MySQL stack.
- Agile project methodology
- Architect complex back-end systems utilizing industry-new technologies.
- Learn from senior full stack engineers and software architect

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Work within a small engineering team while also interfacing with several different departments
- Develop Python and Bash scripts and automation tools to gather data through SQL queries and API tools. 
- Ensure integrity of operations and maintenance of business systems and interfaces into other systems. 
- Conduct analysis and reporting of energy efficiency results and programs. 
- Write software documentation for use of our business and vendor systems.
- Research and test hardware for integration and compatibility with our systems.

positions.title: Network Technician
positions.description:
- Work with a small team of less than 10 networking professionals.
- Ensure integrity of a large university campus network and systems.
- Troubleshoot network issues for faculty and departments using a ticketing system.
- Program/Configure Cisco IOS switches, routers, and access points.
- Created internal inventory tracking website via Python, HTML, and MySQL.

positions.title: Assistant Store Manager
positions.description:
- Manage a staff of 20+ associates and supervisors
- Drive store profitability by setting expectations and KPI targets
- Maintain store operations and inventory with a limited set of resources
- Actively monitor customer satisfaction and sales trend analysis
- Talent recruitment and management training

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
- Ensure customer satisfaction
- Handle monetary transactions
- Inventory control
- Training

positions.title: Student Worker
positions.description:
- Organize college recruiting events and student activities.
- Liaison between students and college
- Suggested and made improvements to the campus

volunteerExperiences.description: Designed to be an annual statewide event, the focus of the 2015 Green Schools STEM Summit is to develop strategies to incorporate sustainability into STEM based curriculum that is experiential and utilizes green classroom environments, school gardens and indoor agriculture to promote innovative, place‐based learning.
